# @kintana/sdk

This package exposes a typed HTTP client (`createKintanaClient`) plus optional React helpers under `@kintana/sdk/react`.

## Auth shape

Supply `Authorization: Bearer <kpa_live_…>` alongside your deployment base URL (hosted app: `https://kintana.app`). Keys are minted inside Kintana **Business → Websites → Custom site**.

## Stable surface

Imports:

- `@kintana/sdk` → `createKintanaClient`, `KintanaApiError`, `pickFormFromList`, public types (`KintanaPublicEvent`, `KintanaPublicFormSummary`, …)
- `@kintana/sdk/react` → `KintanaProvider`, `useKintana`, `ShowsList`, `EventDetail`, `EmbedForm`, `KintanaTracker`

HTTP prefixes (HTTPS only in production):

- `GET /api/public/v1/events?limit=N&tourId=&artistSlug=&venueSlug=&promoterSlug=&scope=all|owned|shared&involvement=lineup|venue|promoter|collaborator|tour&myLineup=true&from=&to=&status=` (status ∈ `on-sale|sold-out|past|cancelled|postponed|…`)
- `GET /api/public/v1/events/{idOrSlug}` — resolves owned **or** shared shows visible to the key workspace

**Shared events:** By default, list/get includes shows the key workspace owns plus shows it is involved in (event/tour collaborator, linked venue/promoter, or lineup artist linked to the workspace). Use `scope=owned|shared` and `involvement=` to filter. Responses include `isShared` and `hostWorkspace`; `ticketUrl` points at the owning workspace’s checkout.
- `GET /api/public/v1/artists` + `GET /api/public/v1/artists/{idOrSlug}` (embeds `socials`, `reels`, `upcomingEvents[]`)
- `GET /api/public/v1/venues` + `GET /api/public/v1/venues/{idOrSlug}` (every venue has a `slug`, detail returns `upcomingEvents[]`)
- `GET /api/public/v1/forms`
- `GET /api/public/v1/forms/{id}/schema` (**5 min public cache + etag**; safe to SSR)
- `POST /api/public/v1/forms/{id}/submit`
- Client helpers: `findForm({ kind, slug })`, `pickFormFromList(forms, opts)` — prefer over hard-coded form ids in env
- `GET /api/public/v1/store/products` + `GET /api/public/v1/store/products/{idOrSlug}` (Pro store enabled; `productUrl` / `storeUrl` for checkout on Kintana)
- `GET /api/public/v1/store/collections` + `GET /api/public/v1/store/collections/{idOrSlug}`
- `GET /api/public/v1/food/menu` (Pro + food ordering enabled; catalog only — QR / show checkout stays on Kintana)
- `GET /api/public/v1/files` + `GET /api/public/v1/files/{id}` (workspace files with **link** visibility only; site-bound keys may only list folders bound to that site)
- Secret key (`kpa_secret_` + `workspace.files` scope, server-only):
  - `POST /api/public/v1/files` — multipart upload (≤4MB), returns `{ file }` with link visibility
  - `POST /api/public/v1/files/upload/presign` + `POST /api/public/v1/files/upload/complete` — direct-to-R2 for files up to 100MB
  - Client: `uploadFile`, `presignFileUpload`, `completeFileUpload`, `uploadFileAuto` (requires `secretApiKey` on `createKintanaClient`)
- Site-bound custom site (requires credential linked to a Custom site row):
  - `GET /api/public/v1/site`
  - `GET /api/public/v1/site/gallery` — ordered items with alt/caption
  - `GET /api/public/v1/site/assets` — named slots (`logo`, `founderHeadshot`, `heroFallback`)
  - `GET /api/public/v1/site/manifest` — gallery + assets + form refs + `updatedAt`
- Client: `getSite()`, `getSiteGallery()`, `getSiteAssets()`, `getSiteAsset(slot)`, `getSiteManifest()`

Exports:

- `@kintana/sdk/locations` ships `groupVenuesByCity()` for `/locations` nav without a bespoke API.

Tracker script (`/_t/k.js`) — **install on every custom/external layout**. Technically optional for server-only REST, but without it: no Kintana Analytics for your domain, no form/widget hydration, no ticket-click attribution. Emits `CustomEvent` hooks: `kintana:pageview`, `kintana:event_view`, `kintana:ticket_click`, `kintana:form_submit` (detail mirrors ingest props).

Out of scope until explicitly launched: generic marketing `pages` CMS, `/stats` KPI aggregates, RRULE recurrence resources, richer embed-field types (`file`, selects, branching logic)—document that integrators keep MDX in their repo for prose.

Starter repos (copy/paste onboarding):

- `https://github.com/kintanaapp/kintana-next-starter`
- `https://github.com/kintanaapp/kintana-astro-starter`

Companion script (`/_t/k.js`) for visitor analytics + hydrating `[data-kintana-form]` / `[data-kintana-widget="event:EVENT_ID"]` (loads `/embed/event/{id}` with full Stripe checkout in an iframe).

- **Recommended on every layout.** Server-only REST works without it, but you lose Kintana-side traffic analytics, embedded forms/widgets, and ticket-click events.
- Paste once per layout; snippet lives under **Business → Websites → Custom site**. For custom developer sites, **`data-token` is the Public key** (`kpa_live_…`) — same env var as REST calls. Never put the Secret key in `data-token`. External-site setup may still mint a short-lived JWT when JWT is configured; custom site credentials always use the Public key.
- HTML shape: `<script async src="{baseUrl}/_t/k.js" data-token="…" data-api-base="{baseUrl}">`
